integrity: The finite-space theorem follows from exhaustive directed-cycle classification of all 4,096 and 16,777,216 temporal-column pairs by two independent-source C++17 programs, with direct reconstruction and evolution of every transfer cycle; proof and exact program sources are provided. No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only initially periodic configurations on indexed binary rings, with primitive temporal periods six and twelve. No attraction-basins, unbounded periods, or full dynamic classification are claimed. Historical priority against unindexed catalogues is uncertain.
title: Period-doubling without period six: exact twelve-cycles of Rule 30
